content.summary: 阿倍朝臣仲麻呂, a student who remained in Tang and is named in the biography among the envoys who came to 鑒眞 in 揚州 in 天寶十二載 (753). The Tang histories name him by his adopted name 朝衡; the chronicle's 寶龜十年 (779) notice records that he died in Tang and that the court gave funeral gifts to his household.
